verified_facts.stak_notice: State of Alaska DNR public notice ADL 422741: preliminary decision, 50-year lease, 715.4 acres, ~26 mi south of Deadhorse, gas-powered facility with modular high-performance computing units. Decision date 2026-05-12, comments closed 06-15. PRIMARY.
verified_facts.chugach: Julie Hasquet, Chugach Electric spokesperson, ADN 2026-05-05. Constraint is GAS, not generation capacity. Do NOT flatten to 'utilities can't serve data centers'.
verified_facts.jber: Air Force solicitation concedes JBER sites have 'insufficient power' and need 'a new connection' to Chugach. af.mil release 2026-02-23, three bases: JBER, Eielson, Clear.
verified_facts.anchorage_zoning: Anchorage Assembly 10-2 vote, March 2026, AO 2026-27, first definition of data centers in the zoning code; requires utility documentation of sufficient system capacity. Say 'in March 2026', no precise day.
verified_facts.gallup: 71 percent of Americans oppose constructing data centers for AI IN THEIR LOCAL AREA, 48 percent strongly. Fielded Mar 2-18 2026, n=1000, published May 13 2026. The words 'in their local area' are MANDATORY.
verified_facts.newsweek: 12 states with gubernatorial candidates backing moratoriums as of July 21 2026. Alaska not listed, but JKT's call was reported July 24, so the omission is a timing artifact. Phrase carefully.
